messages:
michael (Partnerships): Quick sync — draft roadmap for SI cert hands-on labs. Want to align content, infra, and launch comms. Who's available?

sasha (SI Enablement): I can lead curriculum. Proposed modules: 1) Redwood basics & API, 2) Dedicated & Private deployment patterns, 3) Performance tuning + cost controls, 4) Marketplace & partner listing. Each with 60–90m lab.

jordan (Sales Eng): Add a short module on common SI customer personas + pricing scenarios. Sales teams need playbook snippets they can copy.

priya (GTM): +1. We should coordinate a soft launch with partner PMs and schedule a joint webinar. Marketplace listing timing matters for comms.

eli (Infra): For labs we'll need ephemeral Dedicated stacks and a sandbox Private VPC image. ETA to provision images? ~2 weeks if no blockers.

sasha (SI Enablement): For hands-on, propose using preseeded datasets and a 'simulated customer' app. Example lab start command:

```
# spin up lab stack
redwoodctl demo create --stack si-lab-aws --model redwood-v1 --kv-cache true --duration 3h
```

michael (Partnerships): Nice, @sasha — can you draft module outlines + learning objectives by EOD Friday? Also need certification criteria (pass/fail) suggestions.

sasha (SI Enablement): Draft rubric idea: 70% lab tasks completed + 1 short written answer on fallback strategies. Badge issuance via internal LMS.

ana (Legal): We'll need partner terms for lab access + an NDA template for external SIs. I can share a redline by Tuesday.

jordan (Sales Eng): For the playbook, can someone create 2 canned email templates: 1) outreach for enrollment, 2) post-certification handoff to sales ops.

priya (GTM): I'll map webinar timeline. Suggest internal preview (partners + select SIs) 3 weeks from now, public launch 1 week after marketplace listing goes live. Also want a one-pager for marketplace listing.

deploy-bot: calendar link created: https://calendar.company/meet/si-cert-roadmap (event 2026-05-10 10:00 UTC)

eli (Infra): Quick infra note: for Private on-prem labs, we need a lightweight VM image (~8GB) with quantized runtime; coordinate with eng-runtime for kernel flags.

sasha (SI Enablement): Good call. Also thinking about proctored vs unproctored certs. Proctored for partner leads; unproctored for engineers. Thoughts?

michael (Partnerships): Proctored for lead partners makes sense. Keep the unproctored badge lower tier. Need to define renewal cadence (6 months?)

ana (Legal): Renewal cadence is fine, will flag IP and data handling in our partner terms.

jordan (Sales Eng): I'll draft the playbook snippets and sample pricing scenarios by Monday.

priya (GTM): I'll coordinate the webinar invite list and the marketplace copy draft.

michael (Partnerships): Action items recap:
- @sasha: module outlines + rubric (EOD Fri)
- @eli: infra image plan + eng-runtime sync (2w)
- @ana: NDA & partner terms redline (Tue)
- @jordan: playbook templates + sales handoff (Mon)
- @priya: webinar timeline + marketplace copy

Anything missing?

sasha (SI Enablement): Need sample evaluation questions + sample lab dataset. I'll attach mocks to the doc once draft is ready.

michael (Partnerships): Great. If no objections I'll lock the roadmap and ping exec stakeholders tomorrow. :thumbsup:

priya (GTM): :rocket:
